model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the training loss over the number of iterations for five different models: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", ranges from 0 to 140,000 on a linear scale, representing the training steps. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 on a linear scale, indicating the model's loss value. The Vanilla model (purple line with circles) starts at a loss of approximately 3.4 and rapidly decreases to around 2.45 by iteration 140,000. The StrmLLM (n=64) model (blue line with circles) begins at a loss of about 3.4 and declines to roughly 2.65. The SepLLM (n=64) model (orange line with circles) starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at around 2.55. The SepLLM (n=64, H) model (green line with circles) begins at about 3.4 and settles at approximately 2.5. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) model (red line with circles) starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at around 2.5. The SepLLM (n=128) model (dark blue line with circles) begins at approximately 3.4 and ends at around 2.55. All models show a rapid initial decrease in loss followed by a slower, more gradual decline, with the SepLLM variants generally achieving lower final losses than the Vanilla and StrmLLM models.
